# Jorley Freight

Jorley Freight delivers RedlineFlow, a cloud-native contract review platform specializing in dynamic redlining and precise change tracking. Designed primarily for legal teams in technology and financial services sectors, RedlineFlow automates clause extraction and streamlines procurement contract reviews. Since its 2022 launch, RedlineFlow has helped Jorley Freight’s top 50 clients reduce contract review times by 40%, accelerating deal cycles and minimizing human error.

Jorley Freight raised a $6.5M Series A in late 2023, led by VenturePlus Equity. The 18-person team includes lawyers, software engineers, and product managers based in Riverton. Competitors include ClauseCraft Solutions, PactPilot, and LegalLayer AI, though Jorley’s dynamic redlining technology sets it apart.

Open risks include evolving regulatory compliance across jurisdictions and integration challenges with legacy enterprise contract management systems.
